description: Content quality and user experience best practices

rules.rule: Blog posts and landing pages perform best at 800-1500 words
rules.reasoning: HubSpot research shows 800-1500 word pages generate the most organic traffic and backlinks for marketing sites.

rules.rule: Use H3 tags to break up long sections under H2s
rules.reasoning: H3 subheadings improve scanability. 79% of users scan rather than read web content (Nielsen Norman Group).

rules.rule: External links should open in new tabs and be used sparingly
rules.reasoning: Excessive external links leak PageRank and pull users away from your site before converting.

rules.rule: Pages should have at least 2-3 internal links to support site architecture
rules.reasoning: Internal linking distributes PageRank across your site and helps users discover related content.

rules.rule: Marketing pages should include at least 1-2 images to break up text
rules.reasoning: Visual content increases time-on-page by 94% on average (Skyword research). Pure text pages have higher bounce rates.
